candidate_name: El-Raswa LNG Liquefaction & Bunkering Station (Port Said)
sponsor_or_proposer: Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources (MoPMR) + Suez Canal Authority (SCA); Korean partner (unnamed) on feasibility
current_state: Framework MoU signed 2025-11-23 between MoPMR and SCA to build a small-scale LNG liquefaction and storage station at El-Raswa, Port Said, to fuel SCA tugboats/locomotives (marine-fuel/bunkering). Detailed feasibility studies done with South Korean institutional support; a separate Korea MoU reported but not public. No capacity figure, no EPC tender, no FID, no shipyard/financing commitments as of Dec 2025.
missing_threshold_elements: Likely OUT OF SCOPE: this is an LNG liquefaction-and-bunkering station for marine fuel (tugboats) / locomotives, not an import/export trade terminal — bunkering is excluded from the GEM LNG terminals tracker. Also below threshold even if in scope: no capacity, no concrete execution step beyond framework MoU (no EPC/FID/site works).
watch_for: Whether scope grows beyond marine-fuel bunkering into a trade-scale liquefaction/import facility; any EPC/FID/capacity disclosure; confirm bunkering exclusion with methodology if it firms up. Re-check ~2026-12.
notes: Corroborated by 3 independent non-GEM sources, each PASS on url_verifier (token 'Port Said'): LNG Industry (https://www.lngindustry.com/liquefaction/24112025/suez-canal-authority-and-ministry-of-petroleum-ink-lng-deal/), LNG Prime (https://lngprime.com/asia/egypts-suez-canal-to-get-lng-bunkering-terminal/169793/), and Egypt State Information Service (https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/egypt-s-suez-canal-authority-petroleum-min-ink-lng-station-deal/, also PASS on 'Suez Canal'). No gem.wiki/globalenergymonitor.org cited. Not in GEM (no Port Said/Raswa/SCA terminal). Distinct site from existing GEM Egypt terminals (Ain Sokhna FSRU, Sumed FSRU, Damietta FSRU/SEGAS, Idku Egyptian LNG). Researcher: AI-draft (discovery sweep).
